fusions.name: Bare-Handed Brand
fusions.desc: A weapon strike with the metal gripped red-hot in your bare hand, dealing 9 fire damage and setting the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Crucible Overhand
fusions.desc: Hurls a crucible of molten slag that deals 28 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Tempering Heat
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 22% and your fire resistance by 15% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck While Hot
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.
